message.content: {"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && printf '%s\\n' '# HANDOFF - tinydb milestone 1' '' 'Implemented tinydb/journal.py with BatchWriter(db).apply(operations).' '' 'Key decisions:' '- Snapshot = copy.deepcopy(db.storage.read()) before applying; on any error, db.storage.write(snapshot) restores the exact pre-batch state (MemoryStorage returns the live dict, so a deep copy is mandatory).' '- Inserts use table.insert(copy.deepcopy(dict(document))) so no aliasing with caller input.' '- Removes validate doc_id is a positive int (bool rejected) and use table.get(doc_id=...) (string-keyed raw table) to detect missing IDs; missing ID raises ValueError.' '- Rollback also resets table._next_id and clears the query cache so preexisting db.table(chr(95)+chr(100)efault) handles see correct state and IDs are not consumed by failed batches.' '- Non-iterable operations input raises ValueError.' '' 'Verified: pytest -o addopts= -> 265 passed (223 upstream + 42 new in tests/test_journal.py); acceptance_public.py -> 2 passed. Upstream tests untouched (git status shows only new files).' > HANDOFF.md && cat HANDOFF.md"}
